captions.text: Who decides how close / one satellite may come / to [another]?
captions.plain: Who decides how close one satellite may come to another?

captions.text: 16 Oct: a Russian military / satellite came [within 5 km] / of a Finnish company's satellite.
captions.plain: 16 Oct: a Russian military satellite came within 5 km of a Finnish company's satellite.

captions.text: Nothing collided. / But no law or treaty sets / a [minimum distance].
captions.plain: Nothing collided. But no law or treaty sets a minimum distance.

captions.text: The nearest rule: the 1967 / Outer Space Treaty asks / for [due regard].
captions.plain: The nearest rule: the 1967 Outer Space Treaty asks for due regard.

captions.text: Within five kilometres. / Legal minimum distance: [none].
captions.plain: Within five kilometres. Legal minimum distance: none.
